questions.stem: The following are true about nitrate tolerance except:

options.label: B
options.text: Tolerance is seen with intermittent use of sublingual GTN for attacks of angina

options.label: C
options.text: Tolerance develops when GTN is used transdermally

options.label: D
options.text: The reason for tolerance is the generation of reactive oxygen species

questions.answerText: Tolerance is seen with intermittent use of sublingual GTN for attacks of angina
questions.solutionHtml:
Tolerance is seen with intermittent use of sublingual GTN for attacks of angina

Tolerance

Tolerance develops on continuous usage of nitrates because of the generation of reactive oxygen species, which inhibits nitrate activating enzyme mitochondrial aldehyde dehydrogenase Tolerance to nitrates can be overcome by giving drug-free intervalsIntermittent use of sublingual GTN for attacks of angina will not produce tolerance Tolerance develops to GTN, when used orally, transdermally or by continuous i.v. Infusion round the clock and with long-acting agents (sustained release)Tolerance seen with higher dosesCross tolerance occurs among nitrates.

questions.stem: Verapamil acts through blocking:
questions.solutionHtml:
L-type calcium channel

L-type calcium channel, Nimodipine is a dihydropyridine L-type calcium channel blocker. Calcium channel blockers prevent calcium from entering cells in the heart and blood vessel walls and are often used to treat high blood pressure. Nimodipine acts on the CACNA1C calcium influx gene.

questions.stem: Which of the following acts by inhibiting late Na Channels in myocardium?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ranolazine

Ranolazine is a medicine used for the management of angina (heart-related chest pain). It helps to prevent new attacks of angina, but it does not stop an acute attack, once it has started. It relieves chest pain by making the heart work more efficiently.
